items.rationale: Forced entry meets §2.6.1, but contents are covered only if co-insured on the schedule under §§2.6.3 and 4.2.6, which is not confirmed. If covered, €650 is a provisional like-for-like replacement estimate under §7.1.1(d); the €1,000 high-value per-article ceiling does not apply to the everyday items described (§§4.4.5–4.4.6).

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of the forced door
items.rationale: The forced door is covered building damage if the forcible-removal peril is in force (§2.6.2), and necessary emergency re-securing is eligible under §5.2.2. Allow €350 gross for attendance, boarding and basic like-for-like repair, below the €1,000 securing cap and without counting the repair twice under Part 7.
